problem_statement: Build a brand-new /uses page from scratch on the Ovidius Astro blog theme. The route /uses does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty stub). Create src/pages/uses.astro that reuses the site's design system — the BaseLayout shell (header nav + footer), the slate/primary color palette, the Figtree font, the section heading style with the primary underline accent, and the rounded primary button. The page is a personal 'What I Use' gear list: a centered hero-style intro titled 'Uses', a short prose paragraph, then three gear groups (Workstation, Editor & Terminal, Software) — each an uppercase section heading with a one-line blurb and a list of tool items (each item an h3 name + a short description), and a closing 'Read the blog' primary button linking to /blog, followed by the site's Subscribe block. Static page, no interaction.
required_content: A hero-style intro block: h1 'Uses' plus a one-line lede paragraph 'A living list of the gear and apps I reach for daily.', wrapped in the slate-50 header slot so the nav sits above it (design-system reuse).
An intro prose paragraph in the site's prose-slate style explaining the page exists to answer what tools are used.

Gear group 'Workstation': an uppercase h2 with the primary underline accent, a blurb 'The desk setup where most of the writing and coding happens.', and three items (14-inch laptop, 27-inch 4K display, Mechanical keyboard), each h3 name + description.
Gear group 'Editor & Terminal': uppercase h2 accent heading + blurb, three items (VS Code, Fish shell, Git worktrees).
Gear group 'Software': uppercase h2 accent heading + blurb, three items (Figma, Obsidian, Raycast).
A closing rounded primary CTA anchor 'Read the blog' -> /blog, plus the reused Subscribe newsletter block.
design_constraints: Reuse BaseLayout (Header nav + Footer) via the named header slot; do not hand-roll the chrome.
Reuse the section heading pattern: uppercase tracking-wider h2 with the after:bg-primary underline accent (as on the home page 'Latest Articles').
Reuse the primary button style: bg-primary rounded-full px-8 py-2.5 text-white (as the home 'View All Posts' button).
Use the existing slate text palette and Figtree font — no new fonts or colors.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline src/pages/uses.astro = bare empty-body stub (route resolves but renders no design-system content -> check A empty). reference = full page reusing BaseLayout/Header/Subscribe + three gear groups + CTA. bad = reference minus all three gear groups (h2/h3/blurbs) and minus the 'Read the blog' CTA -> only hero+intro shell remains, fails the section/item/CTA dom_assertions. 三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同.
